call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one finished flat fictional folding-cup launch poster, portrait 4:5.

Create a new independent poster. The entire visual arrangement must arise from the HEIGHT DIFFERENCE of the expanded and fully collapsed states of the same folding cup. One continuous, realistic studio photograph, without comparison panels.

Physical scene: Place the expanded cup on the LEFT and the collapsed version of the SAME cup on the RIGHT. Both are upright, side by side, photographed at identical scale, with precisely the same apparent circular rim/lid diameter and a common horizontal ground-contact baseline. They sit at the same camera depth. Use a front three-quarter view with only mild camera elevation so both circular lids can be seen. Do not tilt, overlap or crop either cup. The expanded state is about 1.4 times its rim diameter in height, and the collapsed state is a shallow nested stack about one third of that height. This produces a large usable void above the compact cup alongside the upper part of the tall cup. Keep the two objects close enough that this height relationship creates a single composition.

Product: a fictional handleless 350 mL folding cup, dark forest-green matte silicone body, translucent milky-white circular lid. Use three mechanically plausible broad accordion-wall folds. The expanded and compact states must show matching rim, base ring, lid fit, wall-fold number, material, hue and diameter. In the collapsed state, the same flexible silicone fold sections are nested tightly toward the circular base rather than replaced by unrelated disks. Seat each lid naturally on its rim. Lid translucency should show through soft diffuse milky material; the lid is not opaque white. Blank unmarked product surfaces, with no letters, logo, badges, embossed marks or labels. No handles, straps, loops or accessories.

Photographic finish: Real-photograph-like macro product detail and natural soft studio light, grounded contact shadows directly under both base rings, consistent shadows and highlights, visibly matte silicone and softly reflective frosted lids. Use a bright neutral-white seamless studio floor/backdrop with no visible tabletop edge, no gray moody table setting and no horizon stripe. Do not add lifestyle props, linen, plants, hands or people. The cups remain the photographic subjects; there is no decorative pattern or artificial glow.

Editorial arrangement: FOLN is a MODEST plain identity at the upper-left outer edge, with substantial breathing room, far smaller than the product name and smaller than the product itself. It must not become a huge headline. Put Fold Cup, the Korean action phrase, and the specification into the void that exists ABOVE THE COMPACT CUP and BESIDE THE EXPANDED CUP. Left-align these three pieces to one shared optical axis within that void. The product title is a clear medium-large sans-serif, restrained enough to belong to the space between the product states. The action phrase can wrap naturally after the comma into two readable lines; do not split Korean words. Specification is comfortably readable immediately beneath it. Match type widths and spacing to the actual cup heights and empty area, so function visibly determines placement. Preserve enough clearance from the lids and silhouette to avoid accidental text-object touches.

Reserve a clear lower-left field beneath the common cup baseline for ONE LEFT-ALIGNED commerce group: release date line, preorder window, store URL. All three have the same left alignment and generous line spacing. The release date is clear but not a giant bottom headline. No centered release/store footer, no giant heading across the top, no numbered comparisons, extra state labels, separators, arrows, frames, pictograms or fake microtext. Use dark forest-green typography, a clear hierarchy and exact Korean strokes. The smallest required type must remain comfortably readable at a 720px-wide screen view.

Only these seven display items appear, each exactly once. Preserve wording, all word spaces, punctuation, numbers and symbols. This is a copy inventory, not a required list layout; semantic regrouping and wrapping only at word boundaries are allowed:
FOLN
Fold Cup
가볍게 접고, 다시 펼치다
350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵
2026.12.01 RELEASE
온라인 사전 주문 11.10–11.30
foln.example/store

Render FOLN as fictional plain type, without a new logo symbol or imitation of a real brand. No actual brand or logo anywhere; no letters on either product surface. No invented slogan, fact, watermark, artwork mark or decorative character. The date-range separator is the supplied en dash, the specification includes the centered dot, and RELEASE is separated from the date by a word space.

Output one finished independent flat image, not a mockup, contact sheet, framed print or multipanel image. Preserve mathematically exact portrait 4:5 aspect ratio in the native output if supported. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
